concept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished hyperrealistic horror creature concept art diptych for the sewer action game Drain Damage. Two full-body creatures in separate vertically stacked wide panels, with generous space around silhouettes: TOP a giant rat shape constructed ENTIRELY of thousands of living cockroaches; BOTTOM a huge low-slung alligator shape constructed ENTIRELY of the SAME cockroach swarm. Both face left in readable three-quarter side view. No real mammal flesh, no fur, no reptile skin/scales, no skeleton underneath: every part including rat ears, snout, feet, curling tapering tail, alligator long jaws, legs and tapering tail is interlocked brown-black cockroaches. Clearly readable shiny segmented reddish chestnut wing cases, antennae, six-legged insects crawling over each other in conflicting directions. Ragged living edges with individual roaches breaking off and joining, several loose roaches skitter on damp sewer concrete beneath each. Rat is hunched and aggressive; alligator is broad-jawed and heavy. Horrifying disgusting churning collective, not a cute animal, not a mechanical construct. Strong cool rim light against deep charcoal sewer shadows, warm glints on shells; sufficient tonal separation to see each insect. Concept-art presentation suitable for marketing portrait, highly detailed realistic materials. No text, no labels, no humans, no logos. Show complete silhouettes without cropping. Landscape overall image with two horizontal panels.
